tickets.title: Prepare care-cost runway projection
tickets.text: Prepare a care‑cost runway projection for Helena Cloudpuddle comparing the current 32‑hour‑per‑week aide schedule at $38 per hour with a higher‑coverage scenario, and identify when cash reserves—including the $142,000 in checking and savings at Teacup Comet Bank—would require an increased withdrawal from the $615,000 joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody.
tickets.evidence: Helena asked for a care-cost runway projection comparing the current aide schedule with a higher-coverage scenario and showing when cash reserves would require an increased taxable-account withdrawal; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-05.

tickets.title: Document family caregiver reimbursement approach
tickets.text: Document a family caregiver reimbursement approach for Helena Cloudpuddle that clearly separates gifts, wages, and shared household costs, reflecting Lila Cloudpuddle’s reduced clinic hours for weekday transportation and medication supervision.
tickets.evidence: Lila is reducing her clinic hours to cover weekday transportation and medication supervision, and Helena wants a documented family caregiver reimbursement approach that does not blur gifts, wages, and shared household costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-12.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents
tickets.text: Collect the long‑term care claim file materials for Helena Cloudpuddle, including the full policy contract, claim packet, and elimination‑period instructions from Amber Teapot Life Insurance, as the premium notice alone is insufficient.
tickets.evidence: For long-term care claim file materials, Helena had the premium notice but not the full policy contract, claim packet, or elimination-period instructions requested by Amber Teapot Life Insurance; those materials are needed by 2024-01-10.

tickets.title: Reconcile home-care invoice amount
tickets.text: Reconcile the home‑care invoice amount for Helena Cloudpuddle by comparing Pocket Lantern Home Care’s portal‑billed aide hours for the first service week with Helena’s calendar and aide sign‑in sheet, and determine the correct amount for planning assumptions.
tickets.evidence: Pocket Lantern Home Care’s portal shows more billed aide hours for the first service week than Helena’s calendar and aide sign-in sheet, so the home-care invoice amount is not ready for planning assumptions; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-03.

tickets.title: Prepare financial questions for rehab conference
tickets.text: Prepare financial questions and affordability figures for Helena Cloudpuddle to present at the upcoming care conference with the rehab team, covering home therapy authorization and daily supervision costs.
tickets.evidence: The rehab team set a near-term care conference to review home therapy authorization and daily supervision, and Helena wants financial questions and affordability figures ready for that conversation; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-08.
